mentions.name: Aphorio
mentions.description: Aphorio is a web server and container manager with a dashboard for managing resources. It is built in TypeScript and Node.js with very few dependencies, its WebSockets can send 3,250,000 messages per second on the author's local desktop, and it ships with a perf tool.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Aphorio. It’s a web server and container manager plus dashboard for managing resources and more.
